                                  priority = $5, type = $6, domain = $7, ip = $8, port = $9,
                                  "sourcePort" = $10, source = $11, protocol = $12,
                                  "inboundTag" = $13, "outboundTag" = $14, "nodeScope" = $15,
                                  "updatedAt" = $16
                           WHERE id = $1
